newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 24.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- France Telecom promises to make Ivory Coast's telephone network the leader in Africa after winning bid to run the national phone company Ci-Telcom; plans investments of 250 billion CFA francs, creation of 300,000 new phone lines and 10,000 new jobs.
- No to Violence, says newspaper editorial on growing confrontation between students and police following jailing of three student leaders.
- University crisis continues with students boycotting classes in Abidjan campus; Bouake campus in central Ivory Coast joins today; teachers consider own reaction.
- Military commission investigating former armed forces chief Robert Guei in connection with 1995 alleged coup plot has started secret hearings.

- University Crisis: No war, no peace on campuses - political parties and religious leaders react - President Bedie's promise of double-digit growth for the Ivorian economy heads for failure, writes special contributor Anikpo Daniel.
- Industries demand repayment of government debts amounting to 31 billion CFA.
